title: Constant folding preserves expression evaluation
specification:
inductive Expr where
  | lit : Nat → Expr
  | var : Expr
  | add : Expr → Expr → Expr
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def denote (env : Nat) : Expr → Nat
  | .lit n => n
  | .var => env
  | .add l r => denote env l + denote env r

def Spec (f : Expr → Expr) : Prop :=
  (∀ e env, denote env (f e) = denote env e) ∧
  (∀ a b, f (.add (.lit a) (.lit b)) = .lit (a + b))
constraints: Use only the supplied Std import.

Use local structural recursion to fold both children.
